description.value: The Kop Coffee Roasters is an independent specialty roastery and café founded in 2020 on Annacis Island in Delta, BC, run by a certified Q grader with over a decade of green-bean sourcing experience across Africa. Beyond its single-origin and blended roasts, the shop sells a dedicated line of camping coffee — single-serve bags designed for outdoor use — making it a natural fit for cycle-tourers who want quality coffee on and off the bike. The café sits in an industrial pocket of Annacis Island, a point of interest in itself given the island's unique geography.

address.value: Unit 1B, 1080 Cliveden Avenue, Delta, BC V3M 6G6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's Location and Hours page confirms the business is real and open at Unit 1B, 1080 Cliveden Ave, Delta, BC V3M 6G6, and provides a phone number (604) 800-4605 absent from OSM. Customer testimonials confirm the physical café is operating ('decided to visit the cafe', 'Always a great brew, right on the doorstep of my work on Annacis Island'). No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc. — are mentioned anywhere on the site, so all such fields are null; the OSM community field says Richmond but the website explicitly states Delta, consistent with the URL discovery note.
